items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I had Freddy Jefferson on Piano, I still had Bobby Carroll.

ctx.x: At the Delicate Pines was this basically the same guys or was it different guys?
No, I had altogether different guys and I organized over. I had Freddy Jefferson on Piano, I still had Bobby Carroll.
You didn't have Willard Brown back?
